record.textual_conclusion:
New type of feature has been extracted
in this study, which improved performance of the overall
algorithm. Random forest has been selected as a base
classifier. The highest accuracy out of 4 classifiers with an
accuracy of 98.76% over ISL-HS dataset and 98.68% over
ASL alphabet dataset has been achieved using random forest.
It will not perform very well over dynamic datasets which is
the limitation of our proposed system. Experimental results
show that our system gave better.

runs.outcome: All 3,120 sampled frames were detected. The unshuffled frame and grouped folds were identical because input ordering is contiguous by video; this run diagnosed the split issue.

All 3,120 sampled frames were detected. Frame-stratified accuracy was 99.96794871794872% and video-grouped accuracy was 87.11538461538461%; the contrast confirms that the two conditional protocols are materially different.

gates.reason: The paper specifies a 440-feature per-frame extractor and 100-tree Random Forest, but not Table III's split, cross-validation aggregation, seed, feature-reduction rule, frame-to-video aggregation, or exact metric implementation. Its Tables I/II round RF accuracy to 0.987 for both datasets while Table III reports 98.68 and 98.76.
